_readme: S748, lane 2's cheap piles (2026-11-28). East Los Angeles 31017 (Kinesiology A.A.-T, Academic Plan E031017G) was read from PDF p.240. Its note quotes the movement list's rule, '(minimum 3 units) Select a maximum of one (1) course from any three (3) of the following areas', and the record reads the list as three courses of 1 to 4 units, so its degree reads 54-67 around the printed 60. This read prints pp.239-241 whole, so a session can read the list's own heading line, the 'Subtotal' and 'Total' lines and the electives sentence word for word, for a reconcile step that reads the list at its printed 3 units. One load. No model call, nothing written.

questions.movement_list: The movement-based list's heading and rule line, word for word, with its printed units figure.
questions.totals_31017: The 'Subtotal', 'Cal-GETC' and 'Total' lines of Academic Plan E031017G and the sentence on additional CSU units.
